description: Folder pane verbs. The script loads when the first verb is called.

functions.name: fold
functions.description: Opens or closes the selected folder row (row), every folder row (all), or closes the selected folder or else its parent and selects that (parent). Answers false, with nothing done, unless the folder pane has the focus.

functions.name: focused
functions.description: Answers whether the folder pane has the focus.

functions.name: viewRowCount
functions.description: Answers how many rows the message list shows now. A closed thread counts its root only.

functions.name: viewFindRow
functions.description: Walks the message list from row from, forward or back, and answers the index of the wanted-th row with the flag (unread, flagged or attachment), else of the last such row found, else -1.
